values.meaning: increased stacks on champion/large minion/large monster kill
values.quote: increased to {{as|10|buzzword}} if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, large {{tip|minion}}, or large {{tip|monster}}

values.meaning: window to use empowered attack before it expires
values.quote: empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 10 seconds

mechanics.claim: Siphoning Strike's basic attack gains an uncancellable windup and resets Nasus' basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Siphoning Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nasus'''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: The flat bonus damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: ''Siphoning Strike's'' flat '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: Base and stack damage count as basic damage but also trigger spell effects as spell damage.
mechanics.quote: Both ''Siphoning Strike's'' '''base''' damage and damage from stacks are treated as {{tip|basic damage}} but also trigger spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}

mechanics.claim: Nasus gains stacks from killing any enemy unit, including champions, minions, monsters, wards, turrets, and pets, but not from secondary units killed by other effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Siphoning Strike'' will not generate {{as|stacks|buzzword}} from secondary units killed by other effects (e.g. {{ii|Tiamat}})

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts after the effect resolves.
